title: Fractions & Decimals
description: Class 7 IMO — Fractions & Decimals: advanced multiplication and division, reciprocals, mixed-operation word problems, and decimal multiplication and division by powers of 10 and by decimals.

topics.title: Multiplying, Dividing & Reciprocals
topics.concept: To multiply fractions, multiply numerators and denominators. To divide, multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction (turn it upside down). The reciprocal of a/b is b/a, and the reciprocal of a whole number n is 1/n.

examples.problem: What is the reciprocal of ⅗?

recap: Divide by multiplying by the reciprocal.
Reciprocal of a/b is b/a; of n is 1/n.

topics.title: Mixed Operations & Word Problems
topics.concept:
When an expression has several operations, follow the order: brackets, then × and ÷, then + and −. Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions before multiplying or dividing.

For example, ½ + ¼ × 2 = ½ + ½ = 1, and 2½ × 2 = 5/2 × 2 = 5.

examples.solution: Multiply first: ¼ × 2 = ½, then ½ + ½ = 1.

recap: Order: brackets, then × and ÷, then + and −.
Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first.

topics.title: Decimal Multiplication & Division
topics.concept: To multiply by 10, 100 or 1000, move the decimal point right; to divide, move it left. To multiply two decimals, multiply as whole numbers and place the point with the total number of decimal places. To divide by a decimal, make the divisor a whole number first.
recap: × 10/100/1000 moves the point right; ÷ moves it left.
To divide by a decimal, make the divisor a whole number first.

questions.q: What is the reciprocal of ⅖?

questions.explanation: Any non-zero number divided by itself is 1.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are equal to ¾)?

questions.explanation: Move the point two places right: 25.

questions.q: A ribbon 4½ m long is cut into ¾ m pieces. How many pieces are there?
A pen costs ₹2.50. What do 6 pens cost?

questions.explanation: ⅔ × ¾ = ½, then ½ × ⅘ = 4/10 = ⅖.
